# infisical_pam_folder_approval_policy (Resource)

Create and manage the approval policy of a PAM folder. Accounts in the folder whose template sets `requires_approval` need an approved request before a session launches or credentials are revealed. A folder has at most one policy. Auto-approval rules aren't managed by this resource: updates keep the rules added in Infisical, and destroying the policy deletes them. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

resource "infisical_pam_user" "lead" {
  email = "lead@example.com"
  role  = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_user" "oncall" {
  email = "oncall@example.com"
  role  = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_group" "dbas" {
  group_id = "<group-id>"
  role     = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder_user" "lead" {
  folder_id = infisical_pam_folder.prod.id
  email     = infisical_pam_user.lead.email # also makes Terraform add the user to PAM first
  role      = "admin"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder_user" "oncall" {
  folder_id = infisical_pam_folder.prod.id
  email     = infisical_pam_user.oncall.email
  role      = "operator"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder_group" "dbas" {
  folder_id = infisical_pam_folder.prod.id
  group_id  = infisical_pam_group.dbas.group_id
  role      = "operator"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder_approval_policy" "prod" {
  folder_id = infisical_pam_folder.prod.id
  name      = "prod-access"

  # Approvers must be folder members, and referencing the memberships adds them first.
  approvers = [
    { type = "user", id = infisical_pam_folder_user.lead.user_id },
    { type = "group", id = infisical_pam_folder_group.dbas.group_id },
  ]

  # Can grant themselves access on accounts whose template sets allow_break_glass.
  bypassers = [
    { type = "user", id = infisical_pam_folder_user.oncall.user_id },
  ]

  constraints = {
    access_duration = {
      max = "1d"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approvers` (Attributes Set) The users and groups that can approve a request. One approval from any of them grants it, and each is notified of new requests. Each must be a member of the folder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approvers))
- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the folder the policy covers. Changing it creates a new policy.
- `name` (String) The name of the approval policy.

### Optional

- `bypassers` (Attributes Set) The users and groups that can break glass: grant themselves access without an approver, on accounts whose template sets `allow_break_glass`. Each must be a member of the folder, and there can be at most 20. Defaults to none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bypassers))
- `constraints` (Attributes) Limits on the requests the policy approves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--constraints))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the approval policy.

<a id="nestedatt--approvers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approvers`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the approver's user or group.
- `type` (String) Whether the approver is a `user` or a `group`.


<a id="nestedatt--bypassers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bypassers`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the bypasser's user or group.
- `type` (String) Whether the bypasser is a `user` or a `group`.


<a id="nestedatt--constraints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `constraints`

Optional:

- `access_duration` (Attributes) How long the access a request asks for may last. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--constraints--access_duration))

<a id="nestedatt--constraints--access_duration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `constraints.access_duration`

Optional:

- `max` (String) The longest access duration a request can ask for, such as `1h` or `2d`, from 30 seconds to 7 days. Defaults to `7d`.
- `min` (String) The shortest access duration a request can ask for, such as `1h` or `2d`, from 30 seconds to 7 days. Defaults to `30s`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the PAM folder approval policy by its ID.
# GET /api/v1/approval-policies/pam-access?scope=pam-folder&id=<folder_id> returns the ID of a folder's policy.
terraform import infisical_pam_folder_approval_policy.example <policy_id>
```
